name: GS.joinWoman_worse_left
lines: n : ℕ
w m : Preferences n
μ ν : Matching (Fin n) (Fin n)
hμ : Matching.IsStable (MatchingMarket.ofEquivData w m) μ
hν : Matching.IsStable (MatchingMarket.ofEquivData w m) ν
j i : Fin n
hji : joinWoman μ ν hμ hν j = i
hμji : mPartner μ hμ i = j
⊢ List.idxOf (mPartner ν hν i) (w.prefs i) ≤ List.idxOf j (w.prefs i)
hμw : wPartner μ hμ j = i
case pos
heq : wPartner ν hν j = i
case neg
heq : ¬wPartner ν hν j = i
this : mPartner ν hν i = j
hbranch : joinWoman μ ν hμ hν j = wPartner μ hμ j
⊢ joinWoman μ ν hμ hν j = wPartner μ hμ j
hle : List.idxOf (wPartner μ hμ j) (m.prefs j) ≤ List.idxOf (wPartner ν hν j) (m.prefs j)
⊢ List.idxOf (wPartner μ hμ j) (m.prefs j) ≤ List.idxOf (wPartner ν hν j) (m.prefs j)
hgt : ¬List.idxOf (wPartner μ hμ j) (m.prefs j) ≤ List.idxOf (wPartner ν hν j) (m.prefs j)
⊢ False
hbranch :
(if List.idxOf (wPartner μ hμ j) (m.prefs j) ≤ List.idxOf (wPartner ν hν j) (m.prefs j) then wPartner μ hμ j
else wPartner ν hν j) =
wPartner μ hμ j
hbranch : wPartner ν hν j = wPartner μ hμ j
hle : List.idxOf i (m.prefs j) ≤ List.idxOf (wPartner ν hν j) (m.prefs j)
hlt : List.idxOf i (m.prefs j) < List.idxOf (wPartner ν hν j) (m.prefs j)
⊢ List.idxOf i (m.prefs j) < List.idxOf (wPartner ν hν j) (m.prefs j)
e : List.idxOf i (m.prefs j) = List.idxOf (wPartner ν hν j) (m.prefs j)
⊢ wPartner ν hν j = i
this : List.idxOf (mPartner ν hν i) (w.prefs i) < List.idxOf j (w.prefs i)

steps.tactic: have hμw : wPartner μ hμ j = i := (wPartner_eq_iff μ hμ).mpr hμji
by_cases heq : wPartner ν hν j = i
have : mPartner ν hν i = j := (wPartner_eq_iff ν hν).mp heq
have hbranch : joinWoman μ ν hμ hν j = wPartner μ hμ j := by rw [hji, hμw]

have hle : (m.prefs j).idxOf (wPartner μ hμ j) ≤ (m.prefs j).idxOf (wPartner ν hν j) :=
  by
  by_contra hgt
  unfold joinWoman at hbranch
  rw [if_neg hgt] at hbranch
  exact heq (hbranch.trans hμw)

have hlt : (m.prefs j).idxOf i < (m.prefs j).idxOf (wPartner ν hν j) :=
  by
  refine lt_of_le_of_ne hle (fun e => heq ?_)
  exact ((List.idxOf_inj (pref_list_mem _ (m.valid j).1 (m.valid j).2 i)).mp e).symm

have :=
  opposed_preferences w m ν hν (wj := i) (wj' := wPartner ν hν j) (m' := mPartner ν hν i) (matchW_wPartner ν hν j) hlt
    (matchM_mPartner ν hν i)
